# Debian/Ubuntu packages ext4magic needs to build and to run the test suite.
#
# Two readers share this one file rather than each carrying its own copy :
# .github/workflows/tests.yml (both the "test" and "build-without-root" jobs)
# and .claude/hooks/session-start.sh, which installs these in a Claude Code on
# the web container. Before this file existed the list was hardcoded in all
# three places and could drift silently — issue #47.
#
# Comment lines and blank lines are skipped by both readers ; everything else
# is passed straight to apt-get install.
#
# ext4magic links against e2fsprogs, libmagic, zlib and bzip2, and the suite
# builds its own filesystems with mke2fs and fills them with debugfs.

build-essential
autoconf
automake
libtool
libext2fs-dev
comerr-dev
libmagic-dev
libblkid-dev
uuid-dev
zlib1g-dev
libbz2-dev
e2fsprogs
